launch_local_multithreading: launch a launchpad program in local multi-threading mode with optional node serialization
launch_local_multiprocessing: launch a launchpad program in local multi-processing mode with per-node resource configuration

test_multiprocessing: test a launchpad program in multi-processing mode within an absltest test case with local resources
